about: The inbox: one durable, addressable inbox per agent or person.
description:
`inbox serve` runs the HTTP service of the inbox on a loopback address. Every other command is a client of that service and signs what it sends with the caller's own key.

This page shows a hand-written example of the reference format; the complete document is generated by the inbox repository.

globalOptions.name: json
globalOptions.help: Print one JSON document on standard output instead of text.

commands.about: Serve the inbox on a loopback address until SIGINT or SIGTERM.
commands.description: The backend is `INBOX_BACKEND`: `memory` (the default) is the only one in this stage.

arguments.name: listen
arguments.help: The address to bind: a loopback address only. Port 0 takes an ephemeral port; the first line printed is the URL served.

arguments.name: key_file
arguments.help: The key file: who each request's key id is.

arguments.name: operator_public_key
arguments.help: The operator public key (44 characters of base64) that signed the key file.

arguments.name: max_connections
arguments.help: The most connections served at once.

arguments.name: request_timeout
arguments.help: Seconds a request may take to arrive in full.

arguments.name: max_request_bytes
arguments.help: The longest body read, in bytes.

arguments.name: max_messages
arguments.help: The message count at which a post is answered 503.

arguments.name: max_wait
arguments.help: The longest wait on `pending`, in seconds.

arguments.name: sweep_interval
arguments.help: Seconds between two sweeps of the expiry task.

arguments.name: answer_retention
arguments.help: Seconds an answer taken on silence waits for its sender.

commands.about: Make a key pair: the secret goes to --out (mode 0600, never overwritten); prints the public key.

arguments.name: out
arguments.help: The secret key file to create.

arguments.name: key_id
arguments.help: The key id of this key's entry in the key file (a client key).

arguments.name: principal
arguments.help: The principal of this key's entry in the key file (a client key).

commands.about: Append a key entry: this public key signs for this principal.

arguments.name: file
arguments.help: The key file; created when absent.

arguments.name: operator_secret_key_file
arguments.help: The operator's secret key file.

arguments.name: valid_until
arguments.help: The end of the entry's validity (RFC 3339); 30 days from now by default.

arguments.name: key_id
arguments.help: The key id; an id is never reused.

arguments.name: principal
arguments.help: The principal the key signs for.

arguments.name: public_key
arguments.help: The public key (44 characters of base64), as `inbox key new` printed it.

commands.about: Open the caller's own inbox (again after every restart of the service).

arguments.name: adapter
arguments.help: The wake surface the inbox is read through.

arguments.name: url
arguments.help: The service: http://<host>:<port>.

arguments.name: secret_key_file
arguments.help: The file of the caller's secret key (`inbox key new --key-id … --principal …`); it names the key id and the principal, which is also the address of the caller's inbox.

arguments.name: outbox
arguments.help: The outbox file; default $XDG_STATE_HOME/inbox/outbox.jsonl, else $HOME/.local/state/inbox/outbox.jsonl.

commands.about: Post a note, a request or a decision, signed with the caller's key. Prints the message id.

arguments.name: to
arguments.help: The inbox posted to.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.help: note, request or decision.

arguments.name: body
arguments.help: The body.

arguments.name: body_file
arguments.help: A file holding the body; `-` for standard input.

arguments.name: thread
arguments.help: The thread; the message id by default.

arguments.name: dedup_key
arguments.help: The sender's key of this logical message; the message id by default.

arguments.name: on_behalf_of
arguments.help: The principal whose word this is; the caller by default.

arguments.name: authority
arguments.help: The delegation that lets the caller speak for --on-behalf-of.

arguments.name: reply_shape
arguments.help: What a reply must look like: free, lines=<n> or schema=<reference>.

arguments.name: options
arguments.help: An option of a decision, <letter>=<text>; repeated.

arguments.name: recommended_option
arguments.help: The option the sender recommends.

arguments.name: default_on_silence

arguments.name: request_ref
arguments.help: The id of the decision request where another system records it.

arguments.name: expires
arguments.help: When the message is removed (RFC 3339); created plus 24 hours by default.

arguments.name: url
arguments.help: The service: http://<host>:<port>.

arguments.name: secret_key_file

environment.name: INBOX_BACKEND
environment.description: The backend `inbox serve` keeps the inboxes in: `memory` (the default) is the only one in this stage.

environment.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
environment.description: Without --outbox or INBOX_OUTBOX, the outbox file is $XDG_STATE_HOME/inbox/outbox.jsonl.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Without XDG_STATE_HOME either, the outbox file is $HOME/.local/state/inbox/outbox.jsonl.
